author: Claude (wH:p2), author of the frozen security v3 unit
standing: D-368 CONTESTED after the third exchange. This file records the author's position per finding for the fresh no-context adjudicator. It edits no subject byte; security-freeze.v3.json (9486f6c4…) and all 65 pinned files stay frozen; nothing here adopts, confirms or repairs anything.
authorReproduction: Every counterexample was re-run read-only against the frozen security_unit_lib_v3.py before this position was written; results are quoted per ID. The M6 primary source was fetched (raw runner-images Ubuntu2404-Readme.md: 'Kernel Version: 6.17.0-1022-azure', 'Image Version: 20260823.283.1').

positions.reproduced: admit_root(root with kernelAttestationKeys=[<a known root keyId>]) -> [] (admitted); admit_root(root whose five recoveryAuthority keys repeat one key) -> [] while root.schema.json refuses it (uniqueItems); verify_envelope calls admit_root but never schema validation.
positions.authorView: Section 3.1 says the preview list is empty but the executable rule only resolves references, and the admission boundary is split between schema (never invoked by verify_envelope) and admit_root (no recovery-list duplication rule). The finding is correct.
positions.intendedRepair: admit_root refuses ROOT.KERNEL_ATTESTATION_KEYS_NOT_EMPTY unless kernelAttestationKeys == [] (and the schema pins const []); admit_root re-checks duplication for every key list including recoveryAuthority; one admission boundary admit_root_document(bytes) = parse -> schema -> semantic rules, returning an AdmittedRoot value that verify_envelope requires as its only root argument; retained negatives for both counterexamples.

positions.reproduced: merge_policy(global pathPrefixes ['src'], project pathPrefixes ['src/../private']) -> no refusal, effective scope ['src/../private'].
positions.authorView: _prefix_within is lexical; the normalized member-path rule of section 7.5 was not applied to raw policy sources. The finding is correct; it does not by itself show product access, as the verdict says.
positions.intendedRepair: At raw-policy admission every pathPrefixes member must satisfy normalized_member_path (relative, NFC, no empty/dot/dot-dot segment, no backslash or NUL, <= 1024 bytes) or the policy refuses POLICY.PATH_PREFIX_NOT_NORMALIZED; the narrowing comparison is whole-segment; retained negatives src/../private and src/../../outside plus legal controls src/a (descendant) and srcx (sibling, refused).

positions.reproduced: reconcile_witness: COMMITTED seq true at tail 1 -> OK; PENDING 2 without bodySha256 at tail 1 -> REVERT; PENDING 0 on an empty carrier -> ADVANCE.
positions.authorView: The function validates only the literal MALFORMED sentinel; a supplied dictionary is trusted. The finding is correct.
positions.intendedRepair: A closed witness shape (witnessSchema const 1, projectKeyDigest hex64, grantGeneration int 1..2^63-1, seq int not bool 0..2^53-1, state enum, bodySha256 hex64 required when seq >= 1 and null only at COMMITTED 0, PENDING requires seq >= 1) validated before any comparison; any violation -> QUARANTINE witnessMalformed; only a valid witness authorizes REVERT/ADVANCE; legal INIT/OK/REVERT/ADVANCE and lost-tail controls retained; the three counterexamples retained as negatives.

positions.reproduced: target_within_scope with a grant scope lacking snapshotDigest -> True; verify_effect_request with an empty broker grant scope -> admitted; with the underlying scope lacking snapshotDigest -> admitted; resolve_result(ref, callback) with no effectResult/stat context returns bytes; RESULT_REF_RE uses '$' so 'rr:...:5\n' matches.
positions.authorView: The frozen text promises mandatory checks; the executable guards made them optional-by-absence and the pure helper doubled as the enforcing boundary. The finding is correct and is the most important of the six for the SDK successor.
positions.intendedRepair: verify_effect_request requires the sealed snapshot manifest and refuses AUTHORIZATION.CONTEXT_ABSENT when any of connection map, current binding, journal state, snapshot manifest or grant scope snapshotDigest is missing; the target must lie inside BOTH the broker grant scope and the underlying grant scope, and an empty scope admits nothing; resolve_result takes one required context record {effectResult, expectedRequestSeq, scratchDirStat, selfUid, fileStat, spawnBytesSoFar} with no defaults; all wire grammars use fullmatch (\A...\Z); lower-level pure helpers keep distinct names and are never scored as admission; retained negatives for absent context, empty/foreign/narrowed scopes, missing snapshot binding, trailing-newline ref, and the response-association cases.

positions.reproduced: By reading: section 7.5 HE-1 bullet orders commit and unlink before 'appends RA/RCI/RCO' and names no ICI/ICO although the descriptor may carry IRREVERSIBLE.
positions.authorView: The narrative contradicts durable-authorization-before-effect and leaves two implementable orders. The finding is correct.
positions.intendedRepair: Explicit ordered HE-1 algorithm: admit request and durably append RA; append RCI (REVERSIBLE) or ICI (IRREVERSIBLE) durably before any committed effect; apply from the immutable bounded buffer; append RCO or ICO carrying the actual outcome and the commit id; only then unlink the stage file and send effectResult with the receipt tied to that outcome record; crash/REV cases retained before and after each boundary; FAILED/INDETERMINATE preserved; a missing outcome record never implies not-performed.

positions.reproduced: Primary source fetched: the ubuntu-24.04 hosted image (20260823.283.1) publishes kernel 6.17.0-1022-azure; both frozen Linux templates fix kernelSeries 6.8.0-generic and kernelPackageNamePattern linux-image-6.8.0-*-generic, which no release measurement can replace under the frozen scheme.
positions.authorView: The fleet decision (four D-102 classes) is right and unchanged; the Linux OS-ABI identity members were fixed where they must be measured. The finding is correct and does not reopen the fleet.
positions.intendedRepair: kernel publisher stays fixed (ubuntu, apt-secure, Ubuntu maintainer, archive key), while flavor and series become RELEASE-MEASURED profile members bound per class {flavor: azure|generic, series: <measured on the image>}; the 6.8.0-generic templates are marked illustrative; a non-6.8 Azure-class example (6.17.0-1022-azure on ubuntu-24.04) and a wrong-series negative are retained; acquisition and refusal rules unchanged otherwise.

authorSummary: All six findings are accepted; none is contested. If the adjudicator UPHOLDS, the author will land the repairs above under security v4 paths (new names only; v3 stays frozen) with retained negatives for every counterexample, and the lead's bounded post-UPHOLD confirmation applies. No v4 byte is adopted or confirmed before the ruling.
